_source: Port.xdm (RTD 7.0.1, PortConfigSet/PortContainer/PortPin) + Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture + pins.json (pin_mapbga257 package pin numbers)
_note: pins.json is the legality source for peripheral+signal->pin mapping. This asset defines the PortPin struct template and <pin> header format for the Port config section.

pin_header.description: Format of a <pin> entry inside the Pins tool <function><pins> section. This is the mux identity declaration that links a physical pin to a peripheral signal.
pin_header.source_ref: Port.xdm ConfigTools Pins tool <pin> element; Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture lines 45-60
pin_header.signal_attr_rule: signal attribute = peripheral.lower() + '_' + signal.lower(), e.g. LPUART0 TX -> lpuart0_tx; LPUART0 RX -> lpuart0_rx
pin_header.pin_num_source: pin_mapbga257 field from pins.json for the mapbga257 package (S32K344_257BGA detected from <package> element in .mex common section)
pin_header.tx_template:
<pin peripheral="{PERIPHERAL_ID}" signal="{signal_attr}" pin_num="{pin_num}" pin_signal="{pin_signal}">
   <pin_features>
      <pin_feature name="direction" value="OUTPUT"/>
   </pin_features>
</pin>
pin_header.note_tx: TX gets direction=OUTPUT pin_feature (open element with children)
pin_header.note_rx: RX is input-only: self-closed element with no direction feature

portpin_struct.description: PortPin struct under Port/PortConfigSet/PortContainer[n]/PortPin. Electrical-only configuration; mux identity lives in the <pin> header above. Field set and order derived from Port.xdm and the Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture Lpuart3_Tx/Lpuart3_Rx structs.

Name.description: Symbolic name. Convention: {PeripheralPascalCase}_{SignalTitle}, e.g. LPUART0 TX -> Lpuart0_Tx, LPUART0 RX -> Lpuart0_Rx.

PortPinSiul2Instance.description: SIUL2 hardware instance. SIUL2_0 is the primary instance for S32K344.

PortPinId.description: Unique pin id within the PortConfigSet. Computed dynamically as max(existing PortPinId values) + 1. TX gets max+1, RX gets max+2.

PortPinInitialMode.source_ref: Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture (ConfigTools Pins-tool derived value); NOTE: PORT_GPIO_MODE is NOT in Port.xdm ECUC RANGE for PortPinInitialMode (xdm RANGE uses PORT_PIN_MODE_ADC/_CAN/_DIO/...; xdm DEFAULT is PORT_PIN_MODE_DIO). This value originates from the ConfigTools Pins tool and the fixture, not from Port.xdm.
PortPinInitialMode._xdm_note: Port.xdm:PortPin/PortPinInitialMode RANGE does not include PORT_GPIO_MODE. The Pins-tool/fixture uses PORT_GPIO_MODE as the electrical default for GPIO-mode pins.

portpin_struct.next_id_algorithm: Scan all existing PortPin structs in the target PortContainer; new TX struct index = count of existing structs; TX PortPinId = max(existing PortPinId values) + 1; RX struct index = TX index + 1; RX PortPinId = TX PortPinId + 1.

package_detection.description: The .mex <common><package> element identifies the package variant. Map to the pins.json field for the package pin number.
